messages:
Nora Li: AtlasHealth SIG follow-up. Procurement highlighted Q2.3 (encryption at rest), Q3.2 (KMS rotation evidence), Q4.5 (private deployment/VPC peering), and CAIQ section about key custody. Need artifact bundle + short answers by Thursday EOD. Who can pick which?
Ethan Park: I can do encryption-at-rest and key custody explanation. For hosted customers we use cloud KMS with envelope encryption; for Private we support HSM-backed keys. I have `encryption-at-rest-one-pager.pdf` to attach.
Rita Shah: I'll own KMS rotation proof. We have a rotation policy and a log snippet. Will scrub key IDs and hostnames before uploading.
Omar Velasquez: I'll handle VPC peering and deployment topology diagrams. Also confirm if mutual TLS is required for peering traffic (answer: yes for Private).
Nora Li: Great. sec-bot, please ingest artifacts when ready and give share links. Also legal: any NDA needed for SOC excerpts? AtlasHealth asked for SOC evidence in CAIQ.
sec-bot: Ingestion queued. Please tag files with customer=atlashealth.
legal-bot: SOC excerpts require an NDA or redacted exec summary. We can provide an exec summary without NDA; full SOC2 requires NDA.
Rita Shah: Uploading now: kms-rotation-policy.md and kms-rotation-log-20250125-scrubbed.txt. Replaced keys with `key-<hash>`.
sec-bot: Files uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/kms-rotation-policy.md, https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/kms-rotation-log-20250125-scrubbed.txt
Ethan Park: Encryption doc uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/encryption-at-rest-one-pager.pdf. Includes note: AES-256-GCM, envelope encryption, HSM option for Private deployments.
Omar Velasquez: Topology and VPC peering diagram uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/vpc-peering-diagram.pdf. Note to include: peering requires mTLS and selective CIDR peering for Private customers.
Nora Li: Mapping owners to SIG Qs: Q2.3 -> Ethan (encryption doc), Q3.2 -> Rita (KMS policy/log), Q4.5 -> Omar (VPC diagram). Confirmed?
Rita Shah: Confirmed. One potential blocker: the KMS log contains internal audit IDs that Legal asked to hash. I've hashed them and re-uploaded.
legal-bot: Verified scrubbed logs. Exec SOC summary also ready: https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf. Flagged NDA requirement for full report.
Nora Li: AtlasHealth also wants CAIQ checkbox evidence for key custody and incident notif. I'll draft CAIQ responses referencing these artifacts and the SOC exec summary.
Ethan Park: Quick line to include for CAIQ: "Customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256-GCM with envelope keys stored in managed KMS; HSM-backed key storage is available for Private/on-premise deployments."
Omar Velasquez: And for network controls: "Private deployments support VPC peering with enforced mTLS and IP allowlisting; hosted deployments use TLS1.2+ and customer-configurable IP restrictions."
Nora Li: Perfect. I'll assemble the SIG/CAIQ sheet and post the draft here for a 1-hour review. Deadline to submit to AtlasHealth: Thursday 17:00 PT. If legal needs >24hrs for anything, I'll mark the field as "pending - NDA required".
Rita Shah: All artifacts are live and verified by sec-bot. Sec-bot links: https://s3.redwood.internal/atlashealth/ (files: kms-rotation-policy.md, kms-rotation-log-20250125-scrubbed.txt, encryption-at-rest-one-pager.pdf, vpc-peering-diagram.pdf, soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf)
sec-bot: Checksums and tags verified for all uploaded artifacts.
Nora Li: Thanks team 680  I'll post the assembled responses shortly for final sign-off.
